content: All autonomous task processing follows a fixed, reusable 5-step closed-loop workflow: 1) Perceive (scan recent sessions to identify new/repeating/failing tasks), 2) Retrieve (query local skills, historical sessions, memory-engine, letta, and GitHub for optimal solutions), 3) Decide (select execute/suggest/skip based on historical success rates, task complexity, and user preferences), 4) Execute (auto-create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts, or delegate subtasks), 5) Review (log execution results and update the knowledge base to improve future performance).
